What to record: Identify the project, room, assembly, finish schedule, and active revision.
Record applicator, inspector, or handoff owner plus the relevant date.
Identify substrate, product, color, sheen, lot, and current instructions.
Record approved sample, specification, manufacturer sheet, drawing, or signed standard.
Record last coat, time, film condition, and manufacturer cure guidance.
Record temperature, humidity, airflow, sunlight, and storage orientation.
Record touch, sand, stack, wrap, transport, install, and service release times.
Example: Wrap after 72 h with breathable layer

What to record: Record cleaners, mats, heat, water, hardware, and client use limits.
